item.title: Fly tipping, 24th October
item.description:
Dear Sir/Madam, I would like to report an incident of littering that I witnessed at around 8:00 am on Saturday near St Peter’s & St Paul Catholic Primary School. While I was working nearby, I saw a man throwing rubbish out of his car into the surrounding area. Unfortunately, I had left my phone in my van and was unable to take a photograph at the time. However, I managed to photograph the vehicle’s number plate as the man was leaving. It is very disappointing to see people treating our local environment in this way. Littering makes public spaces unpleasant for residents, children and other members of the community. I would be grateful if the council could investigate this incident using the information and photograph I can provide, and consider appropriate enforcement action if there is sufficient evidence. I hope action can be taken to discourage this behaviour and help keep the area clean. Kind regards

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): St Paul's Wood Hill, St Paul's Cray, Greater London
